title: Reduce historical test-run snapshot reconciliation cost measured at 17–19 ms per large update
outcome: Use the recorded large-state profiling baseline to reduce unnecessary historical test-run reconciliation work while preserving summary identity, diagnostics invalidation and all wire-field changes.
acceptance: The 9293-run rich-summary snapshot path is reproduced with deterministic work-count regression coverage and the existing synthetic profiling setup; the original cost is recorded before changes.

A measured improvement preserves test-run ordering, conservative legacy/detail invalidation and every relevant wire-field change; detailVersion alone is not assumed to certify the whole summary, and the same setup is measured before and after.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the exact candidate passes the full gate before landing.
